hook_line: RO KHANNA HOLDS MORE CASH THAN SEVEN LAWMAKERS COMBINED

hook_stat.sub: Ro Khanna's campaign cash — the largest balance among eight Indian-American House members and members-elect

stats.label: Campaign cash held by the other seven Indian-American lawmakers combined
Second-largest balance, for Shri Thanedar — who reported $14.44 million in campaign debt
Received by Khanna's campaign during the 2026 cycle, against $9.5 million spent

diaspora_bullets: Khanna's $16.6 million balance carries no outstanding debt
Figures come from FEC filings as reported for the 2026 cycle
news_summary: Representative Ro Khanna reported about $16.6 million in campaign cash with no outstanding debt, more than the roughly $11.1 million held by the other seven Indian-American House members and members-elect combined, according to a review of Federal Election Commission records.
payoff: Khanna's balance exceeds the other seven combined by about $5.5 million.
